name: no colours: the first settle publishes '#000000', and Blend Value alone moves nothing
two colours: 0 is Color 0 verbatim, 1 is Color 1, 0.5 is the floor of the midpoint
because: colorblend.ts :155-181 — `#000` and `#fff` at 0.5 give 127 per channel

name: Blend Value is clamped to the list: -1 is Color 0, 5 is the last colour
an unreadable colour at a whole position is passed through verbatim
because: colorblend.ts :159-162 — 'red' and a token work at rest

name: an unreadable colour mid-blend shows the nearer endpoint unblended: 0.25 → 'red', 0.75 → '#fff'
var(--x, #fff) reads through its fallback; var(--x) alone is unreadable without a document
a hole reads as black: color 2 alone, blended from 1.5, is halfway from '#000000'
three-digit hex and rgb() both read; a falsy entry reads as black
a Blend Value that is not a number keeps the colour last shown: halfway grey stays grey through 'abc', and 1 then shows white (D8)
because: P107-D8, ruled 2026-10-05 "Keep last colour, warn once", fixed in P109 ISL-026 (the warning is a runtime error, off the trace); v1 rendered '#NaNNaNNaN' — clamp(NaN), :155-158

name: a number on a colour port at a whole position is passed through as a number
